items.title: 1441 · Rio d'Ouro raid
items.detail: First kidnapping raid on the West African coast.

items.title: 1444 · Syndicate and Lagos
items.detail: A chartered syndicate forms and the Lagos auction sells captives.

items.title: 1452 · Dum Diversas
items.detail: The papal bull authorizes conquest and perpetual servitude.

items.title: 1453 · Zurara completes
items.detail: The commissioned chronicle finishes the racial ideology.

items.title: Order of Christ Patronage
items.detail: Zurara served inside the same military-religious order headed by quinto beneficiary Henry.

items.title: 1486 · Casa dos Escravos
items.detail: King João II establishes the Lisbon royal slave-customs house to tax human cargo.
